items.hed: Texans play Jacksonville in London on Sunday, 8:30 a.m. Central
items.insight: The Houston Texans schedule lists Sunday, Oct. 18, as an away game against the Jacksonville Jaguars at Wembley Stadium, kickoff 8:30 a.m. Central, on NFL Network. Sunday's game at Tennessee is behind them on the club page, which does not print a final, so none is stated here. The next home date is Oct. 25 against the New York Giants, noon Central, on FOX.

items.hed: Astros still have no general manager, and Espada's contract ends this month
items.insight: MLB.com reports the club parted ways with general manager Dana Brown on Aug. 24. Assistant general managers Charles Cook, Gavin Dickey, and Connor Huff, with senior advisor Jeff Bagwell, have carried the work, and owner Jim Crane is overseeing baseball operations. Nearly a week after the White Sox eliminated Houston in two games in the American League Wild Card Series, MLB.com says the search is unchanged. Manager Joe Espada's contract expires at the end of October. He said last week he would like to return. No decision is posted.

items.hed: Rockets finished the Macao preseason; the regular season opens Oct. 20
items.insight: The club's schedule announcement lists two preseason games in Macao against Dallas, Oct. 9 and Oct. 11, as part of the NBA China Games. Both dates are now behind the calendar. The same announcement sets opening-night rosters for Oct. 19 at 5 p.m. Eastern, with the regular season starting Oct. 20. No final from Sunday's game is printed on the page used here, so none is stated.
